completion_decisions: Register T15 as a benchmark/comparison-protocol paper, not a fictitious target optimizer.
Fully reproduce the case-study-1 common evaluator and paper participants 1-10 plus examples.
Retain case-study-2 layouts and the paper 5x5 cross-model matrix without fabricating unavailable participant wake models.
Exclude archive participants 11-12 from the paper-native 2019 matrix.
Preserve and report constraint violations in public submitted layouts rather than silently repairing published comparison assets.

Participant run-level FES and timing reports are inconsistent and cannot be normalized from the paper.
